what: When a big section title reaches 25% up from the bottom of the screen, each letter slides in from 3.47% of the window width (50px at 1440 wide) to the right, from transparent, over 1.2s power2.out — .06s between letters, so the first letter lands first and the last one lands late. Plays once

options.x: Entry distance — a number means px, a value with a unit (2rem · 4vw) uses that unit, default 3.4722vw (original 50rem — in the original 1rem is 1/1440 of the window width, so 50px at 1440 width)
options.scale: Starting size, none by default (size untouched) — with .9 it starts small and pops in to full size (brand-no-oto)

from.where: index.js section titles TOPICS·LIVE·DISCOGRAPHY·MUSIC VIDEO (original registerEffect fadeInLeft — SplitText chars, fromTo opacity 0·x 50rem → 1.2s power2.out stagger .06, scrollTrigger start top center+=25%)

Large English section names (ABOUT·PRODUCTS·PROGRAM) in index.html · STAFF in about.html — original titleanim: once it enters via IntersectionObserver (rootMargin 20px), each span goes x -35 · scale .9 → 0 · 1, alpha 1, .6s Back.easeOut(1.7), staggered by .06s
from.options: x: -35; scale: .9; duration: .6; ease: back.out(1.7); stagger: .06; start: top bottom+=20

from.where: index.html six English section titles (original .split — each letter from .5em to the right and transparent, transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) · 45ms between letters · 82% screen line, option x: .5em; duration: 1.1; stagger: .045; ease: 0.16,1,0.3,1; start: top 82%. In the original only opacity runs separately at .9s cubic-bezier(.21,.22,.25,1))
